usage: 海景 usually refers to a view of the sea from a location such as a house or a hotel room.
The word 海景 is a noun and can be used as the object of a sentence or as part of a compound noun.
You can describe a property as having a 海景 to emphasize its attractiveness because the sea view is often considered desirable.
海景 can be combined with other nouns to form phrases like 海景房 (sea view room) or 海景公寓 (sea view apartment).
When using 海景 in a sentence, it typically precedes or follows the noun it describes, depending on sentence structure.
